answer: What survives to the violet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the vine of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the relic re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
